prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Creation Progress & Desk Preview: Enhance the waiting screen with detailed generation progress stages (rigging, sprite rendering, desktop sync) and desktop location previews. (why: The waiting screen takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while 3 support tickets noted pets failing to show on desktop.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Adoption Certificate First Flow Sequence: Place the introductory story step immediately into a card layout before path choice to build emotional investment before option selection. (why: Choose path takes 8s median / 514s mean with 79.1% dropoff; setting story context first improves user engagement.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Requirements & Fail-Safe Guidance: Add photo selection quality guidelines (bright lighting, single subject) and automatic fallback pet selector options on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo generation failures or poor output quality during adoption.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Stage Layout Path Selector: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a stage layout to highlight path options clearly without overwhelming the user. (why: Path selection mean time is high (514s), suggesting users spend too long deciding or get confused.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Sound & Desktop System Notification: Enable audio notification and desktop pop-up alerts when pet generation finishes during the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step has a huge mean time (2336s), indicating users tab away during long setup times.)
